{{Top|leg}}
An '''irrigation bulb''' was an item found in a [[Medpac/Legends|medi-pack]]. It was a small, disposable container filled with a cleansing fluid used on small wounds. The bulb incorporated a nozzle for the application of the cleansing liquid onto the affected area.
